channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Danny Ainge | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Danny Ainge from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Danny Ainge, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Ryan Smith:

“Well, I have Danny Ainge running the franchise. He had the number one pick and moved back to get Jayson Tatum—which no one saw coming. So if anyone's open to it, it’s him.”

Ryan Smith on Danny Ainge, Jayson Tatum, May 12, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Danny Ainge, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Sasha Vujačić:

“So anyhow, Rudy (Tomjanovich) says, ‘He played for me before. You’re young. You’re coming from Europe. I think we’ll have a better chance with him.’ And I hadn’t even gotten to the locker room—I already called my agent. My agent at the time was also Kobe’s agent, Rob Pelinka. I was going crazy. They’re telling me, ‘Calm down. You might not be in his plan, but you're in the plan of the franchise.’Then Kobe called me. Kobe calmed me down. I was like, ‘This is crazy.’ Funny fact—one of the teams I was supposed to go to was Boston. Danny Ainge and I had a great workout, and I was like, ‘Damn, do I just kill my dream?’”

Sasha Vujacic on Danny Ainge, Rob Pelinka, Apr 9, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Al Jefferson:

“Iget to the hotel, and I’m sick as a dog the next morning—completely messed up. My workout was terrible. I was off the whole time. I can’t even remember everything that happened. But that’s how I knew Danny Ainge really wanted to draft me, because they offered to have me come back for a second workout. I was too ashamed to go. I mean, after that performance, I couldn’t show my face again. After that, though, I had good workouts with other teams.”

Al Jefferson on Danny Ainge, Dec 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tony Allen on Danny Ainge, Nate Robinson
item.description:
Tony Allen:

“It was no greater feeling—I ain’t even gonna lie— than to beat Doc. Like I say, man, I told a lot of websites this, a lot of podcasts this. You know, I was in Boston before I came to Memphis. Like I said, I asked Doc and Danny Ainge, 'Hey, man, give me a third year.' They wanted to re-sign me to the same deal, but they put a lot of belief in Nate Robinson—shoutout Nate Robinson. But after winning the championship and going to the finals, you know, I thought I was embedded in the team. I thought I was family to the Celtics, you know what I’m saying?”

Tony Allen on Danny Ainge, Nate Robinson, Nov 24, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ice Cube on Danny Ainge, Cedric Maxwell
item.description:
Ice Cube:

“Danny Ainge. He just looked like a little brat. But he could shoot and he hustled. I ended up meeting him and he’s a cool dude, but man in those series in the ’80s he would get under my skin. Him and Cedric Maxwell.”

Ice Cube on Danny Ainge, Cedric Maxwell, Aug 3, 2023. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Taylor Hendricks on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Taylor Hendricks:

“I had a really good talk with Danny Ainge, the owner, and the head coach, and they made me feel pretty comfortable there.”

Taylor Hendricks on Danny Ainge, Jun 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on being traded and seeing the Jazz torn down:

“I wouldn’t say I was surprised.… I knew Danny (Ainge) … was trying to do what he thought was good for the future of the franchise.”

Rudy Gobert on Danny Ainge, Oct 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Justin Zanik on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Eric Walden:Justin Zanik, on the offseason he and Danny Ainge had:

“This is the craziest and longest offseason of his career,and certainly of mine. If I had to use one word, it would be 'never-ending.'”

Justin Zanik on Danny Ainge, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Danny Ainge, Dennis Johnson
item.description:
Pacers coach Rick Carlisle said during the NBATV broadcast.

“I know what he went through in Boston. When I was drafted there, we were in the Finals three straight years. Anytime a depth player went in the game, the magnifying glass, the microscope is on you. You had to really do your job at a high level, otherwise Dennis Johnson and Danny Ainge are coming back in there. He experienced the same thing, but he did have some good stretches. ...”

Rick Carlisle on Danny Ainge, Dennis Johnson, Jul 13, 2022. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra said he didn't know @Dwyane Wade was coming.

“He's living a life. Front row Utah games. And front row here. It's an incredible thing. It just looks weird when he's sitting there (in Utah).... and next to Danny Ainge?”

Erik Spoelstra on Danny Ainge, May 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on the @Utah Jazz addition of Danny Ainge:

“Adding Danny and his breadth of experience both in management and playing, coaching -- I think it just adds to a group that's already very strong.and I look forward to it.”

Quin Snyder on Danny Ainge, Dec 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Danny Ainge, KC Jones
item.description:
Stevens:

“We hear stories about his teams occasionally. I work for a guy who was a part of those teams, so, yeah, we hear about those teams. More importantly, Danny (Ainge) just left my office telling KC Jones stories. It's a tough day.”

Brad Stevens on Danny Ainge, KC Jones, Dec 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Danny Ainge
item.description:
“So I get back to my hotel [in Phoenix], I’m about to fly back home for like two days before I go to New York [for the draft] and my agent called me and he’s like, ‘Danny Ainge called and said they’re going to trade their [No. 1] pick, they’re going to go to 3 and they want you to come to Boston the next day to work out,’”

Jayson Tatum on Danny Ainge, May 11, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Danny Ainge
item.description:
“And the vision he was saying -- you ever have somebody talking to you, and as they’re talking to you, you can see what they’re saying so much that you’re not even looking at him no more? Painting a picture, and that’s how he was painting it. This is Danny Ainge’s greatness, him being able to lure you in with his charming ass. Next thing you know he was finessing me.”

Kevin Garnett on Danny Ainge, Feb 15, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Doc Rivers, Danny Ainge
item.description:
Brian Robb:Kevin Garnett on his upcoming jersey retirement:

“I’m honored and thankful to have my number retired with the Celtics. I will always have immense respect and appreciation for ownership, Danny Ainge, Doc Rivers, my past teammates and Celtic Nation!”

Kevin Garnett on Doc Rivers, Danny Ainge, Feb 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Ray Allen on Danny Ainge
item.description:
“I had a conversation with (Ainge) and I told him this was my last-ditch effort. I would’ve went back,”

Ray Allen on Danny Ainge, Nov 15, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Asked if he has directly asked Irving to come back, the Celtics co-owner said,

“I haven’t talked to Kyrie in those terms, and our two free agent negotiators are Brad and Danny (Ainge). But Kyrie knows how we feel about him,that we feel very positive about him, and the discussions will go on over the next few weeks.”

Kyrie Irving on Danny Ainge, Jun 13, 2019. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Steve Kerr:

“Danny Ainge has done one of the best jobs of anybody in terms of building a team from the ground up.”

Steve Kerr on Danny Ainge, Jan 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Danny Ainge, Brad Stevens
item.description:
“That’s Danny (Ainge) and Brad (Stevens) and those guys — and, I mean, obviously the players, too,”

Doc Rivers on Danny Ainge, Brad Stevens, Jul 15, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Michael Jordan, Danny Ainge, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Clyde Drexler
item.description:
Dominique Wilkins:

“It’s frustrating at times, but the thing that really satisfies me is that my peers know what I’ve done. The guys like Larry Bird and Dr. J and Michael Jordan and Clyde Drexler and Magic Johnson, they all know and they’ve all said some wonderful things. And I’ll tell you one of the guys who has [shown a lot of respect] too is Danny Ainge. Some of the things he’s said recently shed a lot of light on what I did. But when you don’t win a championship [it hurts your perception]. There are a lot of guys who didn’t win a championship, but does that diminish how great they were? No.”

Dominique Wilkins on Michael Jordan, Danny Ainge, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Clyde Drexler, Jun 8, 2018. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Jordan Mickey on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Jordan Mickey on Cs restructuring:

“GMs do what they think is best for the team and that’s what Danny Ainge did. I’m a little surprised, but hey, he’s a geniusand he knows what he’s doing.”

Jordan Mickey on Danny Ainge, Dec 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Bradley said of his trade to the Pistons.

“There were (conversations) that me and Danny Ainge had, but when it does happen, it still catches you off guard a little bit destination-wise, where you end up. “I know it’s part of the business so I respect their decision and I know that Danny is going to make the best decision for the Boston Celtics.”

Avery Bradley on Danny Ainge, Nov 27, 2017. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I talked to Danny Ainge today and he’s all for that. And I respect him for that, just having some type of purpose, some type of action behind your message, have some type of result-based actions that produce something.”

Jaylen Brown on Danny Ainge, Sep 25, 2017. Source: celticswire.com.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Jay King:Thomas on trades:

“I know if (Ainge) does it, it's going to be a decision to make the team better. But I'm fine with the guys we have now.”

Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge
item.description:
“I sat down with Danny Ainge, and he was talking about how much of a fan he’s been of mine since the draft,”

Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge, Feb 15, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: RJ Hunter on Danny Ainge
item.description:
Hunter told Basketball Insiders.

“Danny [Ainge] comes down and he calls me over and we walk upstairs. It felt a lot like that Donald Trump show, ‘The Apprentice.’ He calls me up and the doors shut harder than the doors have ever been shut before, and I just kind of knew it. He was like, ‘We’re going to let you go.’ Afterward, I just had to go because a lot of emotions were coming out at the time, and I just had to get myself out of there.”

RJ Hunter on Danny Ainge, Nov 8, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge
item.description:
“I'm excited. I think we've got the right pieces to go forward. Danny Ainge and those [front office] guys, they might have a little bit more work to do but, at the same time, the group that we have, I'm excited about the opportunity to get together and get things going. I'm anxious to get a new season going because it should be a lot of excitement around here in Boston.”

Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge, Aug 14, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Danny Ainge, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Marcus Smart on Jaylen Brown being ready to rip somebody’s head off:

“I like it. I like it. And I think Danny [Ainge] loves it.”

Marcus Smart on Danny Ainge, Jaylen Brown, Jun 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Danny Ainge
item.description:
“(Celtics president of basketball operations)Danny (Ainge has) given me a list of seven or eight guys to really look at. And then obviously we have so many other guys coming in at other pick opportunities, and we'll see everybody come through. It'll be probably hard for a true sleeper to get by us. So it's really a great opportunity with the number of picks we have, where we are with that (No. 3) pick in the draft. And there's so much yet to be determined.”

Brad Stevens on Danny Ainge, May 20, 2016. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Jared Sullinger on Danny Ainge
item.description:
I'm perfectly fine with that,'' said Sullinger, in an interview with ESPNBoston.com on Sunday night.

“It's not that I need it. It's the simple fact that I know what kind of person I am, and I would never get back to the weight I was [this season].''Ainge said he wants to believe Sullinger has gotten the message and will lose the weight.”

Jared Sullinger on Danny Ainge, Mar 24, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.
